extraction.decision: Approve a bounded 90-day dispatch-assistant pilot for two dispatch teams.
extraction.recommendation: Run the bounded two-team pilot without committing to a full rollout.
extraction.causal_rationale: The pilot would replace continued manual work with production evidence about adoption and time recovery; the sampled baseline is 96 manual hours per month, with an estimated recovery of 48–67 hours per month, while waiting another quarter preserves the workload and yields no adoption evidence.
extraction.largest_risk_or_uncertainty: Adoption may differ between teams, and no production adoption evidence currently exists.
extraction.explicit_ask: Approve the pilot budget and name an operational owner.
extraction.deadline_or_timing: Complete approval and owner assignment by 2026-08-15; run the pilot for 90 days, with a week-four checkpoint and an end-or-redesign condition if active adoption remains below 50%.
